name: Spending Money
overview: Scripture teaches that the ability to acquire wealth is a gift from the LORD, who empowers us to prosper according to His covenant (Deuteronomy 8:18). Believers are called to honor God with their possessions and to wisely manage their resources, avoiding vanity and debt (Proverbs 3:9; 13:11; 22:7). True life is not measured by material abundance but by faithful stewardship and generosity, leaving a godly inheritance for future generations (Proverbs 13:22; Luke 12:15).
